|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V)]]. Other errata versions: [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB2-156-Through_The_Force_Things_You_Will_See-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 8 November 2026); the card type is the release sheet's (the card list does not show it). The release-sheet slip shows the original text (see [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V)]]); the Players Committee card image shows the PC-E2 text (see [[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Through The Force Things You Will See (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 2 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), an Out Of Play Interrupt.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Virtual Block 2 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022152656/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, through 11 January 2013) changed “than Force Pile” to “than in Force Pile”. The card list does not show the card type.<ref name="cl-1220_156">Players Committee website card list (VBlock2Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064711/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 21 July 2012] and, unchanged, [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142857/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock2Type.html 11 January 2013] (Internet Archive)</ref>
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Through The Force Things You Will See (V) (Errata 2)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) changed “If” to “Once per game, choose: if”, has “than Force Pile” again, and changed the card type from Out Of Play Interrupt to Lost Interrupt.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee announced this text on 19 November 2012, effective immediately, the day it removed the Out Of Play Interrupt subtype from the game (the post heads the card “LOST INTERRUPT”)<ref name="pcforum-p768283">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post by Aglets, 19 November 2012 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20150320030739/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/forums/viewtopic.php?f=871&t=36574#p768283 Internet Archive copy], captured 20 March 2015)</ref>.
